_note: Least privilege for the API roles (Nov 2, 2026). Every browser call is signed in: user_profiles (App, Auth, AdminDashboard), analysis_history (StockAnalyzer, AnalysisHistory), watchlists (watchlistApi). users and score_log are server-only (api/ routes use the service role). anon needs nothing. user_profiles writes are column-limited (the browser inserts id, email, username, is_admin and updates credits_remaining and analyses_total_lifetime); the insert policy allows is_admin only for the admin email. Known app-design gap, not fixable in the database: credits are deducted in the browser, so a user can still set their own credits_remaining.
